title: Viewer's theory that the stranger was a kachina spirit guide

tellings.quote: "That's a cachina that came to make sure you were on the right path."

plain: A stranger whom Geoffrey Drumm met in Egypt was, according to one viewer, a kachina, a spirit being from the traditions of the Pueblo peoples of the American Southwest, sent to check on him. Drumm, a pyramid researcher who says an alien explained the pyramids' true purpose to him, tells Michels that a viewer named Vince wrote, 'That's a cachina that came to make sure you were on the right path.' If so, his meeting in Egypt would have been a guided encounter rather than chance.
